name: conflict-fixer
title: Conflict fixer
description: Every 3 hours: on the maintainer's and the routines' open pull requests with merge conflicts, merges the default branch, resolves the conflicts, runs the CI checks and pushes a signed merge commit.
notes: It never rebases or force-pushes, and leaves conflicts in protected paths or incompatible design choices to the maintainer with one comment. PROFILE.md must name the changelog's unreleased section, the generated files and their generator command.
